alt: 兩位朋友淋雨受困，身旁各有壞掉的腳踏車，相依分享麵包。
scene_prompt: Two friends in casual clothes sit shoulder to shoulder under one small tree in a rainstorm; both have broken bicycle wheels beside them, both muddy and equally stranded far from home. One offers the other half of a small bread roll; their rueful sympathetic expressions show shared hardship. This illustrates the sense of friends both in trouble and facing adversity together, not the equally talented brothers sense.
